en.name: Hikvision DS-2CD1343G0-I Dome Camera
en.shortDescription: 4MP outdoor IP dome camera with 30m night vision.
en.description:
## Hikvision DS-2CD1343G0-I

A weatherproof 4MP IP dome camera built for 24-hour outdoor monitoring.

- 4MP resolution, H.265+ compression
- 30m IR night vision
- PoE powered, IP67 weatherproof
